name: Monitor
what: The board you can read and the agent you can reach. One slide per Train of Thought topic - state, intent, the unanswered questions, the last key messages - with a dot for every topic. A click is a Tell Mom tell: it posts to Tell Mom (:8139), whose pane channel inserts a note into Echidna's thread, and then asks Echidna's own agent (:8138) so the reply is a turn in the same session the pane is showing. If either door is down the button says which, rather than linking somewhere dead.
